decisions.reason: Door lever handle family builds directly on the firm's core metal fabrication knowledge, enabling effective interpretation of market feedback and incremental improvement.
Door handle design is closely related to existing metal-forming capabilities, so the firm can assimilate early results and refine the product.

Electronic access systems are distant from the firm's fabricated-metal knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve the product, so management drops it to refocus on core competences.
